prompt:
Deliverable: one painterly dark gothic anime light-novel event illustration, landscape 16:9, a single finished opaque interior scene with exactly two seated adult characters and nobody else; the reference images are numbered below the prompt.
SUBJECT: two characters, each drawn at full identity fidelity. FADYME is an adult woman aged 22, drawn exactly as the woman in reference image 1, with the same face, hair, eyes and costume: pale ash-blonde hair, a cool light beige-blonde with ash-grey shading, in long soft waves falling to the chest; violet eyes, a pale lavender-grey violet; a deep plum hood raised over her head, plum fabric (#45293B in the light, #22151E in shadow) with silver-lilac (#C9B6E4) vine embroidery along the hood edge and the mantle borders; on the front edge of the hood above the brow one small broken fragment of a silver circlet; one tiny silver bell-shaped hairpin at the side of her face, partly hidden by the hood edge and her hair; under the mantle a black high-collar dress with silver-lilac embroidery and a high, clean, white scarf (bone ivory, #E9E2D4) folded up under her chin; thin, matte, dark gloves; her small silver bell, with a long slender silver thorn as its clapper hanging still, rests on the cloak beside her knee on its fine silver chain. MAHMUT is an adult man aged 28, a tall weathered former sworn palace guard, drawn exactly as the man in reference image 2, with the same face, hair and armour: dark messy hair, stubble along the jaw and chin, brown eyes, tired but steady; dark worn half-plate repaired in several mismatched styles by village smiths, with a dark steel gorget, a breastplate and layered pauldrons with patched plates and mismatched rivets, fully visible because his cloak is not on his shoulders; a small Crown Guard star mounted on the centre of the breastplate and, directly above it, a small empty hammered-out socket, bare roughened plate, where a crown once sat; scarred, scuffed gloves; no helmet, no raised hood; his sword stays sheathed at his hip. Mahmut is clearly taller and broader than Fadyme, who is the smaller and slighter of the two.
SETTING: the inside of a modest abandoned stone roadside shelter in the Whispering Ash Forest, at evening. Story canon, quoted: "A broken roof appeared through the branches. There was still enough of it to promise a dry corner." and "Inside, the wind softened to a sound in the rafters." It is one small room of weathered grey stone blocks with moss in the joints and textured ancient stone underfoot. The back wall stands behind a long, low bench of cold stone built along it. The roof has partly fallen: bare dark timber rafters, a few slates still on them, and a ragged gap through which a patch of dim, cool violet-grey dusk sky shows; a few fallen slates lie in the far corner. The left side of the room is open: no wall, only a low broken stub of wall, and through the opening the quiet, empty, narrow muddy road runs between pale ash-grey trees in low mist. Greens outside stay grey-green and desaturated.
ACTION: canon, quoted: "He laid his cloak over the cold stone." and "He sat. His shield rested within reach; her shoulder rested almost within reach of his." Mahmut's tattered oxblood cloak, Guard red dyed darker into a deep brownish crimson (lit mid-tone #6B1E2C, shadow #371C21) with bold ragged torn edges, lies spread over the stone bench beneath them, its torn edges hanging over the front of the bench. They sit side by side on it, Fadyme on the left of the picture, Mahmut on the right, their shoulders a hand's width apart and not touching. Fadyme's body is turned a little toward him but her head is turned to the left of the picture, looking out through the open side at the quiet road, her gaze distant and a little wistful, her closed lips holding the faintest soft smile. Mahmut sits more upright, his head turned toward her, his eyes on her face, his mouth closed; understated care, tired but steady, softened around the eyes. A plain round loaf of bread is broken in two: she holds the smaller half in her gloved hands in her lap, and the larger half rests in his scarred gloved hand on his knee. His repaired dark heater shield leans against the right-hand wall at the end of the bench, within reach of his hand: heater-shaped (wide flat top, sides tapering to a point at the bottom), plain dark face, bevelled iron rim, riveted repairs, one tiny abstract round seal impression pressed into the rim, no heraldry. Calm, hushed, restrained, understated.
COMPOSITION: eye-level camera at seated height, a medium shot of the two seated figures from the head down to the knees, the pair centred slightly right of the middle of the picture (about 28% to 72% of the width), the open side filling the left 22% and the shield and the side wall at the right. Measured as fractions of the picture height from the top: the top 12% is deep shadow of dark rafters with no bright spot; the dim sky gap shows in the upper centre between about 8% and 26% of the height and 36% to 62% of the width; the top of Mahmut's hair is at about 17% and the top of Fadyme's hood at about 26%, so she sits visibly smaller, about half a head lower, her shoulders about two thirds as wide as his; his eyes are at about 28% and hers at about 37%; both faces, all hands and the bread sit between 14% and 72% of the height; the lowest 28% is quiet: the bench, the hanging folds of the cloak and the stone floor, with no bright spot and no detail that draws the eye.
STYLE: painterly dark gothic anime light-novel illustration, detailed faces and eyes, thin soft plum-black linework on the figures (never pure black), slightly heavier on the outer silhouettes; soft cel shading on the skin in two or three value steps; painterly gradients and fold occlusion on matte woven cloth, worn dull metal and scuffed leather; the architecture painted with soft edges and no outlines, painted masonry, visible brush grain and paper tooth, no gloss. Quiet, hushed, melancholic, understated.
LIGHT AND PALETTE: evening, the last light leaving the road: cool slate ambient light (#3B434D and #474A54) on the stone, faces, hands and cloth, and a dim cool violet-grey dusk (#474A54 with a faint plum tint) in the roof gap and outside. One low warm amber light (#D9A441) far down the road at the far left of the picture, entering through the open side at about 50% of the height, gives a thin warm rim to the left edge of Fadyme's hood, cheek, hands and bread and to the left of Mahmut's hair, pauldron and gorget; no other warm light, no fire, no lantern, no sun disc, no rays. A faint cool silver-lilac (#C9B6E4) edge light traces the outline of her plum hood so it separates from the dark wall. Charcoal-violet shadows (#22151E, never darker than #0F0D11), stone in cold greys, plum, silver-lilac and bone ivory on her costume, oxblood only on the cloak; low saturation except the plum, the lilac and the single amber; most of the picture is dark, nothing pure black or pure white, the brightest highlight no brighter than #F2EDE4.
TECHNICAL: an opaque full-bleed painting filling the whole canvas edge to edge, no letterbox bars, frame or border; the background is a painted stone interior with the forest road outside, not a flat colour; text-free.
Do not include: text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks; extra, missing or fused fingers; a third person, animals; a white streak in her hair, blood on her scarf, glowing lines on her skin; red, burgundy or gold clothing on Fadyme, a bright red or purple cloak, a cloak worn on his shoulders, a helmet, a crown, a royal crest or a round shield; modern items, glasses, a fire; chroma-key green, borders, UI.
